extracted.intended_audience: Japan Patent Office examiners, patent attorneys, agents, and applicants interacting with the JPO
extracted.subtask_description: Comprehensive English index of the Japan Patent Office's Examination Guidelines covering examination principles, requirements for description and claims, patentability (novelty, inventive step, eligibility), amendments, priority, special procedures, foreign-language and international filings, patent-term extension, and utility models.

rubrics_metrics.name: Principles of Examination and Flow of Examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 1: Principles of Examination and Flow of Examination
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Overview of the fundamental principles and procedural flow used by examiners; full text available in the linked PDF (Chapter 1).

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedures of Examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Chapter 2: Procedures of Examination
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General procedural rules governing examination activities; see linked PDF for procedural details and step-by-step guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Specifying Claimed Invention
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 1: Specifying Claimed Invention
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on how to interpret and specify the subject matter of claims during examination; detailed rules in the linked section PDF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior Art Search and Determination of Novelty, Inventive Step, etc.
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 2: Prior Art Search and Determination of Novelty, Inventive Step, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards and methods for conducting prior art searches and assessing novelty and inventive step; see linked PDF for methodology and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice of Reasons for Refusal
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 3: Notice of Reasons for Refusal
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirements and content for issuing official notices that explain grounds for refusal; procedural and substantive expectations are set out in the linked guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handling of Written Opinion, Written Amendment, etc.
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 4: Handling of Written Opinion, Written Amendment, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: How written opinions and amendments submitted by applicants should be considered and processed by examiners; see PDF for timing and evaluation criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decision
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 5: Decision
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards and procedures for making final examination decisions (grant/refusal); consult linked guidance for decision-making criteria and documentation requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decision of Dismissal of Amendment
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 6: Decision of Dismissal of Amendment
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criteria and process for dismissing proposed amendments to an application; detailed rules in the linked PDF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reconsideration by Examiners before Appeal Proceedings
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 7: Reconsideration by Examiners before Appeal Proceedings
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedure and standards for internal reconsideration by examiners prior to formal appeals; see linked section for applicable timelines and factors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Communication with Applicant and Request for Documents etc. Required for the Examination
rubrics_metrics.description: Section 8: Communication with Applicant and Request for Documents etc. Required for the Examination
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards for interlocutory communications and document requests during examination, including what examiners may request and how applicants should respond.

rubrics_metrics.name: Enablement Requirement (Patent Act Article 36(4)(i))
rubrics_metrics.description: Part II, Chapter 1, Section 1: Enablement Requirement (Patent Act Article 36(4)(i))
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirement that the patent description enable a person skilled in the art to carry out the invention; full statutory interpretation and examples are given in the linked PDF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ministerial Ordinance Requirement (Patent Act Article 36(4)(i))
rubrics_metrics.description: Part II, Chapter 1, Section 2: Ministerial Ordinance Requirement (Patent Act Article 36(4)(i))
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific requirements imposed by ministerial ordinances related to description/enablement; consult the linked section for exact compliance criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for Disclosure of Information on Prior Art Documents (Patent Act Article 36(4)(ii))
rubrics_metrics.description: Part II, Chapter 1, Section 3: Requirements for Disclosure of Information on Prior Art Documents (Patent Act Article 36(4)(ii))
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Obligations to disclose known prior art information in the description; see PDF for required content and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent Act Article 36(5) — Requirements for Claims (overview)
rubrics_metrics.description: Part II, Chapter 2, Section 1: Patent Act Article 36(5)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: General statutory framing of claim requirements; linked section contains interpretation and how examiners apply Article 36(5).

rubrics_metrics.name: Support Requirement (Patent Act Article 36(6)(i))
rubrics_metrics.description: Part II, Chapter 2, Section 2: Support Requirement (Patent Act Article 36(6)(i))
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Requirement that claims be supported by the description; guidance and examples illustrating adequate vs inadequate support are in the linked document.

rubrics_metrics.name: Clarity Requirement (Patent Act Article 36(6)(ii))
rubrics_metrics.description: Part II, Chapter 2, Section 3: Clarity Requirement (Patent Act Article 36(6)(ii))
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards for clarity of claim language and claim scope; examples of unclear claim drafting and corrective measures provided in the linked PDF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conciseness Requirement (Patent Act Article 36(6)(iii))
rubrics_metrics.description: Part II, Chapter 2, Section 4: Conciseness Requirement (Patent Act Article 36(6)(iii))
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Expectations that claims be concise (avoid unnecessary limitations or repetition); see linked guidance for interpretation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Ministerial Ordinance Requirement on Statement of Claims (Patent Act Article 36(6)(iv))
rubrics_metrics.description: Part II, Chapter 2, Section 5: Ministerial Ordinance Requirement on Statement of Claims (Patent Act Article 36(6)(iv))
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Formal requirements for how claims must be presented per ministerial ordinance; consult section PDF for formatting and content rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unity of Invention (Patent Act Article 37)
rubrics_metrics.description: Part II, Chapter 3: Unity of Invention (Patent Act Article 37)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criteria for when multiple inventions may or may not be present in one application and how unity is assessed; the linked chapter and the longer 'Requirements for Unity of Application' reference provide tests and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Eligibility for Patent and Industrial Applicability (Article 29(1))
rubrics_metrics.description: Part III, Chapter 1: Eligibility for Patent and Industrial Applicability (Main Paragraph of Article 29(1) of Patent Act)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards for subject-matter eligibility and industrial applicability of inventions; statutory interpretation and examples in the linked chapter.

rubrics_metrics.name: Novelty (Patent Act Article 29(1))
rubrics_metrics.description: Part III, Chapter 2, Section 1: Novelty
rubrics_metrics.guidance: How novelty is determined against prior art; tests, relevant date rules, and examples are provided in the linked PDF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Inventive Step (Patent Act Article 29(1) and (2))
rubrics_metrics.description: Part III, Chapter 2, Section 2: Inventive Step
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frameworks and factors for assessing inventive step (non‑obviousness) and examiner practice; see detailed guidance and examples in the linked section.

rubrics_metrics.name: Procedure of Determining Novelty and Inventive Step
rubrics_metrics.description: Part III, Chapter 2, Section 3: Procedure of Determining Novelty and Inventive Step
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Stepwise procedures examiners should follow when assessing novelty and inventive step, including selection of closest prior art and problem-solution approaches; detailed process guidance in PDF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Claims Including Specific Expressions
rubrics_metrics.description: Part III, Chapter 2, Section 4: Claims Including Specific Expressions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on how to treat claims that include particular phrasing or specific expressions that may affect novelty/inventive-step assessments; see examples in linked material.

rubrics_metrics.name: Exceptions to Lack of Novelty of Invention (Patent Act Article 30)
rubrics_metrics.description: Part III, Chapter 2, Section 5: Exceptions to Lack of Novelty of Invention (Patent Act Article 30)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statutory exceptions (e.g., grace periods, certain disclosures) that prevent loss of novelty; linked section describes eligible circumstances and required proof.

rubrics_metrics.name: Secret Prior Art (Patent Act Article 29bis)
rubrics_metrics.description: Part III, Chapter 3: Secret Prior Art (Patent Act Article 29bis)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Treatment of prior art that is not publicly available at the filing date (secret prior art) and when it may affect patentability; see linked guidance for examiner approach.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior Application (Patent Act Article 39)
rubrics_metrics.description: Part III, Chapter 4: Prior Application (Patent Act Article 39)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: How prior-filed applications (e.g., earlier filings by same applicant or others) are treated with regard to novelty and priority; consult the chapter for rules and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Category of Unpatentable Invention (Patent Act Article 32)
rubrics_metrics.description: Part III, Chapter 5: Category of Unpatentable Invention (Patent Act Article 32)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Types of subject matter excluded from patentability under the Act (statutory exclusions); linked section lists categories and provides interpretative guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Requirements for Amendments (Patent Act Article 17bis)
rubrics_metrics.description: Part IV, Chapter 1: Requirements for Amendments (Patent Act Article 17bis)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards for allowable amendments to description, claims, or drawings during prosecution; see linked chapter for scope and restrictions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment Adding New Matter (Patent Act Article 17bis(3))
rubrics_metrics.description: Part IV, Chapter 2: Amendment Adding New Matter (Patent Act Article 17bis(3))
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criteria for determining whether an amendment adds matter beyond the original disclosure (prohibited new matter) and examiner responses; examples in the linked PDF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment Changing Special Technical Feature of Invention (Patent Act Article 17bis(4))
rubrics_metrics.description: Part IV, Chapter 3: Amendment Changing Special Technical Feature of Invention (Patent Act Article 17bis(4))
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Assessment of amendments that alter a 'special technical feature' and when such changes are permissible; see guidance for tests and examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amendment for other than the Prescribed Purposes (Patent Act Article 17bis(5))
rubrics_metrics.description: Part IV, Chapter 4: Amendment for other than the Prescribed Purposes (Patent Act Article 17bis(5))
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Limits on amendments made for purposes other than those allowed by statute; linked section describes disallowed amendment intents and consequences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Priority under the Paris Convention
rubrics_metrics.description: Part V, Chapter 1: Priority under the Paris Convention
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules for claiming and proving priority under the Paris Convention, including time limits and required documentation; see linked chapter for procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Internal Priority
rubrics_metrics.description: Part V, Chapter 2: Internal Priority
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules for claiming priority from earlier filings within Japan (internal priority); details and conditions set out in the linked section.

rubrics_metrics.name: Division of Patent Application (Patent Act Article 44) — Requirements for Division
rubrics_metrics.description: Part VI, Chapter 1, Section 1: Requirements for Division of Patent Application (Patent Act Article 44)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Conditions under which an application may be divided into divisional applications and procedural requirements; consult section PDF for time limits and content rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Notice under Article 50bis
rubrics_metrics.description: Part VI, Chapter 1, Section 2: Notice under Article 50bis
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural notice requirements related to division/conversion under Article 50bis; see linked guidance for when and how notices are issued.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conversion of Application (Patent Act Article 46)
rubrics_metrics.description: Part VI, Chapter 2: Conversion of Application (Patent Act Article 46)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Rules and procedures for converting between types of applications (e.g., patent↔utility model); linked section contains procedural steps and conditions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent Application Based on Utility Model Registration (Patent Act Article 46bis)
rubrics_metrics.description: Part VI, Chapter 3: Patent Application Based on Utility Model Registration (Patent Act Article 46bis)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures for filing a patent application that claims priority from a utility model registration; see detailed requirements in linked PDF.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reference filing (Patent Act Article 38ter)
rubrics_metrics.description: Part VI, Chapter 4: Reference filing (Patent Act Article 38ter)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on filings that refer to other filings (e.g., incorporation by reference) and the conditions for acceptable reference filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Overview of Foreign Language Written Application System
rubrics_metrics.description: Part VII, Chapter 1: Overview of Foreign Language Written Application System
rubrics_metrics.guidance: High-level description of the system allowing foreign-language written applications and the applicable rules; linked chapter provides scope and prerequisites.

rubrics_metrics.name: Examination of Foreign Language Written Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Part VII, Chapter 2: Examination of Foreign Language Written Application
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures and standards for examining applications filed in foreign languages, including translation requirements and examiner treatment; see very detailed linked PDF (large file).

rubrics_metrics.name: International Patent Application
rubrics_metrics.description: Part VIII: International Patent Application
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on processing international (PCT) patent applications entering the Japanese national phase; see linked chapter for national-phase requirements and timelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extension of a Patent Term as Compensation for the Curtailment of the Term (Patent Act Article 67(2))
rubrics_metrics.description: Part IX, Chapter 1: Extension of a Patent Term as Compensation for the Curtailment of the Term (Patent Act Article 67(2))
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Criteria and procedures for granting patent-term extension to compensate for regulatory delays or curtailment; consult linked section for calculation and eligibility rules.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extension of Patent Term for Pharmaceutical Inventions (Patent Act Article 67(4))
rubrics_metrics.description: Part IX, Chapter 2: Extension of Patent Term for Pharmaceutical Inventions (Patent Act Article 67(4))
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specific rules for patent-term extensions applicable to pharmaceutical inventions, including special eligibility and procedural requirements.

rubrics_metrics.name: Basic Requirements for Utility Model Registration
rubrics_metrics.description: Part X, Chapter 1: Basic Requirements for Utility Model Registration
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Standards for utility model registration distinct from patentability (e.g., novelty and industrial applicability interpretations for utility models); see linked chapter for specifics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Utility Model Technical Opinion
rubrics_metrics.description: Part X, Chapter 2: Utility Model Technical Opinion
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedures for issuing technical opinions for utility models and the criteria used; see linked guidance for examiner practice and applicant options.

rubrics_metrics.name: Handling Procedures for Examinations involving Product-by-process Claims
rubrics_metrics.description: Separate guidance page: Handling Procedures for Examinations involving Product-by-process Claims
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Special handling rules for claims that define products by the process of manufacture; see the dedicated linked page for detailed examiner practice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Applicable periods and applications of these Guidelines
rubrics_metrics.description: Note on applicable periods and applications of these Guidelines (scope / effective dates)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Defines which versions of the guidelines apply to which filing/examination dates and includes revision history; consult note for transitional provisions.

rubrics_metrics.name: Relevant Provisions (statutory cross-references)
rubrics_metrics.description: Multiple 'Relevant Provisions' PDFs linked across Parts I–IX
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collections of statutory text and regulatory provisions referenced in the Guidelines; examiners and practitioners should consult these for exact legal wording.
